correctness.rationale: An explicit forbidden-arc incidence calculation proves all exact finite means and covariances. A connected-cumulant expansion yields a trivariate unconditioned CLT, factorial moments establish Poisson short-cycle limits, and the deterministic bounded-change coupling proves asymptotic independence; a positive acyclic-event probability transfers the CLT. Determinant factorization proves full covariance rank; fixed fourth-moment bounds prove conditional scaled covariance convergence. The independent exact enumeration checks all nine finite identities for n=2,3,4 and three rational p values.
